name: keyspacesstreams
description: Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra) change data capture (CDC) records change events for Amazon Keyspaces tables.

subcommands.name: get-records
subcommands.description: Retrieves data records from a specified shard in an Amazon Keyspaces data stream.

subcommands.name: get-shard-iterator
subcommands.description: Returns a shard iterator that serves as a bookmark for reading data from a specific position in an Amazon Keyspaces data stream's shard.

subcommands.name: get-stream
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about a specific data capture stream for an Amazon Keyspaces table.

subcommands.name: list-streams
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all data capture streams associated with your Amazon Keyspaces account or for a specific keyspace or table.
